spec.description: Active connections as % of max_connections. Yellow >70%, Red >90%
spec.title: Connection Pool Utilization

spec.description: Temp files written to disk — indicates work_mem is too low
spec.title: Temp Files (Bytes/s)

spec.description: Lock counts by mode. Spikes indicate contention.
spec.title: Lock Tables

spec.description: Dead tuples per table — high values mean autovacuum is not keeping up
spec.title: Dead Tuples (Top 10 Tables)

spec.description: Autovacuum and autoanalyze runs per hour per table
spec.title: Autovacuum Activity

spec.description: Sequential scans vs index scans — high seq_scan on large tables = missing index
spec.title: Seq Scan vs Index Scan (Top 10 Tables)

spec.description: Background writer buffer allocation and clean rate
spec.title: Buffers (bgwriter)

spec.description: Replication lag in seconds. Should be close to 0.
spec.title: Replication Lag

spec.description: Idle in transaction connections hold locks and block autovacuum — dangerous!
spec.title: Idle in Transaction (Dangerous!)

spec.description: Used vs available connections vs max limit
spec.title: Connection Pool Status

spec.description: Max duration of active transactions. Growing = hung query. Yellow >30s, Red >60s
spec.title: Max Transaction Duration

spec.description: Committed and rolled back transactions per second
spec.title: Transaction Throughput

spec.description: Cache hit ratio — should be >99%. Low = excessive disk I/O.
spec.title: Cache Hit Rate

spec.description: Row operations per second: inserts, updates, deletes, fetches
spec.title: DML Operations Rate
